detail.longDescription: I'm using a dev dependency in my project that is released as a binary before it gets published as an npm package. The latest version has a feature I requested, and I want to develop with it now, so I can feedback before it's published. I know how to grab the binary in a script that pnpm will run for me. But I'm not sure how to declare this 'cutting edge dependency'? Is this something pnpm can help with, or do I just need to 'hack' my package file, knowing that pnpm will ignore it?
